newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria's Stoyanov elected president - official.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria's Stoyanov elected president - official.

text.p: Bulgarian opposition candidate Petar Stoyanov won Sunday's presidential election run-off with 59.73 percent of the vote, the electoral commission said on Wednesday.
Final results given by a commission spokesman showed Culture Minister Ivan Marazov, candidate of the governing Socialists, polled 40.27 percent.
"The Central Electoral Commission unanimously declares Petar Stefanov Stoyanov elected president," the spokesman told state radio.
The figures put turnout at 61.49 percent, close to the 63 percent who voted in the first round on October 27.

The president's powers are largely ceremonial but the defeat of the governing Socialists has widened splits in the party and 19 leading members published a letter on Tuesday calling for a new cabinet and wide-ranging policy changes.
A leadership plenum is scheduled for Monday.
